guide.title: OSS Writing Style Guide
guide.version: No version or date stated in the guide

severityMapping.error: The guide says must, never, always, or an unconditional don't, and the check is reliable.
severityMapping.warning: The guide says should, prefer, or avoid, or the item comes from a use-this-not-that table, or the check is reliable but has known exceptions.
severityMapping.suggestion: Heuristic approximations and soft advice. Labeled heuristic in the hover card when the pattern can only approximate the guideline.
